exposure: Fentanyl (25 mcg) + Ropivacaine (0.375%) via TAP block
Dexmedetomidine (25 mcg) + Ropivacaine (0.375%) via TAP block
cohort: The study included 60 patients undergoing infra-umbilical surgeries, randomly divided into two groups.
finding: Dexmedetomidine as an adjuvant with Ropivacaine in TAP blocks provided more effective postoperative analgesia with a higher mean duration of analgesia, less pain, and lower drug demand compared to Fentanyl, without significant side effects.
